data.title: Negative transfers are accepted
story: Report from the QA team: a transfer of -5,000 was accepted, and the sender balance went up instead.
Never trust user input. A transfer is valid only when the amount is more than 0 and not above the balance.
data.starter:
def valid_transfer(amount, balance):
    return amount <= balance
data.solution:
def valid_transfer(amount, balance):
    return amount > 0 and amount <= balance

explanation: The old code only checked the upper limit, so negative numbers and zero slipped through. User input must have its range checked on both sides before it is used.
hints: Add a condition that the amount must be more than 0.
Join both conditions with and: amount > 0 and amount <= balance.
